text:
Wendy: Recap from Ventra's procurement call — they need an auditable CSV export showing per-route token usage + cost for the past 90 days and a short enablement session for finance. They said no CSV = no signature. :grimacing:
Luis: What's the exact schema they want?
Wendy: They asked for columns: account_id, route, date, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, cost_usd, error_flag, user_hash (hashed email ok). Delivery: presigned S3 link.
Nora: We can build this from events_warehouse. Two cautions: redact transcripts (only include transcript_length), hash user emails with a salt stored in Secrets Manager, and run during low-traffic window.
Ellen: I'll prepare a 1-pager and 15m walkthrough showing how to pivot the CSV into chargebacks and the template email for finance. I'll record it.
Luis: Product note: recurring ask. I'll file a backlog ticket for "account export: per-route CSV + admin Console export" with acceptance: schema doc, RBAC for admins, presign TTL, audit log.
Wendy: Action items: 1) Nora to drop redacted CSV to ops S3 and share presigned link by Wed EOD. 2) Ellen to prep playbook + recording. 3) Luis to create product ticket and tag security for RBAC.
CS-Bot: Reminder — Ventra renewal check-in scheduled in 9 business days (calendar invite sent).
Wendy: I'll confirm timeline with Ventra after the CSV is available.
